name: @cafemenu/platform-functions
description: The platform project's backend: requests from the console, done with @cafemenu/deployer by a GitHub Actions job (src/worker/), or by Cloud Functions on Blaze.

scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/copy-rules.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --config firebase.emulators.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-cafemenu "node --test tests/emulator/provision.emulator.mjs"
scripts.test:emulator:worker: node scripts/copy-rules.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --config firebase.emulators.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-cafemenu "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/emulator/worker.emulator.mjs tests/emulator/admin.emulator.mjs"
scripts.emulators: node scripts/copy-rules.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:start --config firebase.emulators.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-cafemenu
scripts.deploy: node scripts/stage.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only functions
